_note: Candidate registry for Kentucky 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Kentucky Secretary of State, Candidate Filings with the Office of the Secretary of State, Election: 2026 General Election (US Senator and US Representative listings; retrieved 2026-10-16), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Kentucky Secretary of State, Candidate Filings with the Office of the Secretary of State, Election: 2026 General Election (US Senator and US Representative listings; retrieved 2026-10-16) (https://web.sos.ky.gov/CandidateFilings/); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
